title: DP11888 The Fall of Capital Punishment and the Rise of Prisons: How Punishment Severity Affects Jury Verdicts
title_zh: 死刑的衰落与监狱的兴起：惩罚严厉程度如何影响陪审团裁决
title_primary: 死刑的衰落与监狱的兴起：惩罚严厉程度如何影响陪审团裁决
title_secondary: DP11888 The Fall of Capital Punishment and the Rise of Prisons: How Punishment Severity Affects Jury Verdicts
authors: Anna Bindler, Randi Hjalmarsson
official: 官方在线 2017-03-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies the effect of punishment severity on jury decision-making using a large archival data set from the Old Bailey Criminal Court in London from 1715 to 1900. We take advantage of two natural experiments in English history, which result in sharp decreases in punishment severity: the offense specific abolition of capital punishment in the 1800s and the temporary and unexpected halt of penal transportation during the American Revolution. Using a difference-in-differences design to study the former and a pre-post design to study the latter, we find that decreasing expected punishment (especially via the end of the death penalty), had a large, significant and permanent impact on jury behavior, generally leading to the jury being ‘harsher’. Moreover, we find that the size of the effect differs with defendants’ gender and criminal history. These results raise concerns about the impartiality of juries as well as the implicit assumption often made when designing and evaluating criminal justice policies today – that the chance of conviction is independent of the harshness of the penalty.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1715年至1900年间伦敦老贝利刑事法院的大型档案数据集，研究了惩罚严厉程度对陪审团决策的影响。我们借助英国历史上的两个自然实验，这些实验导致了惩罚严厉程度的急剧下降：19世纪针对特定罪行废除死刑，以及美国独立战争期间刑罚流放制度的暂时且意外的中断。采用双重差分设计研究前者，采用前后对比设计研究后者，我们发现预期惩罚的减少（尤其是通过废除死刑）对陪审团行为产生了显著且持久的影响，总体上导致陪审团变得更加“严厉”。此外，我们发现影响的大小因被告的性别和犯罪前科而异。这些结果对陪审团的中立性以及当今刑事司法政策设计与评估中常隐含的假设——即定罪概率与刑罚严厉程度无关——提出了质疑。

title: DP20892 A More Conservative Country? Asylum Seekers and Voting in the UK
title_zh: 一个更保守的国家？英国寻求庇护者与投票行为
title_primary: 一个更保守的国家？英国寻求庇护者与投票行为
title_secondary: DP20892 A More Conservative Country? Asylum Seekers and Voting in the UK
authors: Francesco Fasani, Simone Ferro, Alessio Romarri, Elisabetta Pasini
official: 官方在线 2025-12-05 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper provides the first causal evaluation of the political impact of asylum seekers in the UK. Although they are dispersed across areas on a no-choice basis, political bargaining between central and local governments introduces potential endogeneity in their allocation. We address this concern with a novel IV strategy that exploits predetermined public-housing characteristics. Focusing on 2004-2019, we estimate a sizeable increase in the Conservative-Labour vote share gap in local elections: a one within-area standard deviation increase in dispersed asylum seekers widens the gap by 3.1 percentage points in favour of the Conservatives. We observe a similar shift to the right in national elections and longitudinal survey data on voting intentions, along with an increase in the Leave vote in the Brexit referendum. Electoral gains are observed for UKIP as well, although this finding is less robust. No effect is detected for non-dispersed asylum seekers, who forgo subsidised housing and make independent residential choices. Turning to mechanisms, voters move to the right without becoming more hostile towards foreigners. Leveraging the universe of MPs' speeches, we show that representatives from more exposed areas emphasise asylum and migration more, with no systematic change in tone or content. This heightened salience appears to shape voters' choices, with Conservative MPs particularly effective at channelling discontent.
abstract_zh: 本文首次对英国寻求庇护者的政治影响进行了因果评估。尽管他们被无选择地分散安置于各地区，但中央与地方政府之间的政治协商在其分配中引入了潜在的内生性。我们通过一种新颖的工具变量策略来解决这一问题，该策略利用了预先存在的公共住房特征。聚焦于2004年至2019年，我们估计地方选举中保守党与工党得票率差距显著扩大：分散安置的寻求庇护者每增加一个区域内标准差，该差距将扩大3.1个百分点，有利于保守党。在全国选举及关于投票意向的纵向调查数据中，我们也观察到类似的右倾转变，同时英国脱欧公投中的脱欧票数有所增加。选举收益同样见于英国独立党，尽管这一发现稳健性较弱。对于非分散安置的寻求庇护者，未检测到任何效应，这些人放弃补贴住房并自主选择居住地。转向机制分析，选民转向右翼，但并未对外国人表现出更强的敌意。利用议员演讲的全样本数据，我们显示来自受影响较大地区的代表更频繁地强调庇护与移民议题，但在语气或内容上并无系统性变化。这种显著性的提升似乎塑造了选民的选择，其中保守党议员在引导不满情绪方面尤为有效。

title: Procedural rationality, endogenous sampling, and the instability of defection
title_zh: 程序理性、内生抽样与背叛的不稳定性
title_primary: 程序理性、内生抽样与背叛的不稳定性
title_secondary: Procedural rationality, endogenous sampling, and the instability of defection
authors: Srinivas Arigapudi, Jonathan Newton
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine cooperation and defection in populations where individuals use both procedural rationality and imitation to choose their strategies. For a broad class of sampling-based choice procedures that encompasses both procedural rationality and imitation, we characterize the conditions under which universal defection is unstable. The results highlight that for cooperation to emerge and persist, the manner in which agents generate and share information can be as important as the underlying payoff incentives.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在个体同时运用程序理性与模仿来选择策略的群体中的合作与背叛行为。针对一类广泛的基于抽样的选择程序，该程序涵盖了程序理性与模仿，我们刻画了普遍背叛不稳定的条件。结果表明，要使合作得以涌现并持续，代理人生成和分享信息的方式可能与潜在的收益激励同样重要。

title: The impact of AI and cross-border data regulation on international trade in digital services
title_zh: 人工智能与跨境数据监管对数字服务国际贸易的影响
title_primary: 人工智能与跨境数据监管对数字服务国际贸易的影响
title_secondary: The impact of AI and cross-border data regulation on international trade in digital services
authors: Ruiqi Sun, Daniel Trefler
official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: International trade in digital services, including mobile app trade (e.g., Facebook in Frankfurt, Instagram in Istanbul), is large and rapidly growing. Analyzing 2015–2020 data on 28,000 mobile apps, we find that AI increases an app’s user base threefold, a massive effect. AI’s handmaiden is data, including cross-border flows of personal data. Concerned with privacy and national security, policymakers have responded with thousands of conflicting data regulations, ranging from guaranteeing free trade in data (USMCA) to data export bans. We are the first to show that these regulations matter: AI’s massive effect is halved in countries with strict data flow restrictions.
abstract_zh: 包括移动应用贸易（如法兰克福的Facebook、伊斯坦布尔的Instagram）在内的数字服务国际贸易规模庞大且增长迅速。基于2015至2020年间28,000款移动应用的数据分析，我们发现人工智能使应用的用户基础扩大了三倍，这一效应极为显著。人工智能的辅助因素是数据，包括个人数据的跨境流动。出于隐私和国家安全的考量，政策制定者已出台数千项相互冲突的数据法规，从保障数据自由贸易（如USMCA）到禁止数据出口不等。我们率先证明这些法规具有实质影响：在数据流动限制严格的国家，人工智能的巨大效应减半。

title: DP19314 Portfolio management with big data
title_zh: 大数据下的投资组合管理
title_primary: 大数据下的投资组合管理
title_secondary: DP19314 Portfolio management with big data
authors: Francisco Penaranda, Enrique Sentana
official: 官方在线 2024-07-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The purpose of this survey is to summarize the academic literature that studies some of the ways in which portfolio management has been affected in recent years by the availability of big datasets: many assets, many characteristics for each of them, many macro predictors, and various sources of unstructured data. Thus, we deliberately focus on applications rather than methods. We also include brief reviews of the financial theories underlying asset management, which provide the relevant background to assess the plethora of recent contributions to such an active research field.
abstract_zh: 本综述旨在总结近年来大数据集可用性对投资组合管理产生影响的学术文献，涵盖众多资产、每项资产的多种特征、众多宏观预测指标以及各种非结构化数据来源。因此，我们特意侧重于应用而非方法。我们还简要回顾了资产管理背后的金融理论，为评估这一活跃研究领域近期大量贡献提供相关背景。

title: Monetary Policy with Persistent Supply Shocks
title_zh: 持续供给冲击下的货币政策
title_primary: 持续供给冲击下的货币政策
title_secondary: Monetary Policy with Persistent Supply Shocks
authors: Galo, NuÃ±o,, Renner, Philipp, Scheidegger, Simon
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies monetary policy in a New Keynesian model with persistent supply shocks, that is, sustained increases in production costs due to factors such as wars or geopolitical fragmentation. First, we demonstrate that Taylor rules fail to stabilize long-term inflation due to endogenous shifts in the natural interest rate. Second, we analyze optimal policy responses under discretion and commitment. Under discretion, a systematic inflationary bias emerges when the shock impacts the economy. Under commitment, the optimal policy adopts a lean-against-the-wind approach without compensating for past inflation, implying that "bygones are bygones". We further extend the model to incorporate the zero lower bound (ZLB) and show that the optimal policy supports preemptive easing.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了一个包含持续性供给冲击的新凯恩斯模型中的货币政策，此类冲击指因战争或地缘政治分裂等因素导致的生产成本持续上升。首先，我们证明泰勒规则因自然利率的内生变动而无法稳定长期通胀。其次，我们分析了相机抉择和承诺下的最优政策应对。在相机抉择下，当冲击影响经济时，会出现系统性的通胀偏差。在承诺下，最优政策采取逆风而行的方式，而不对过去的通胀进行补偿，这意味着“既往不咎”。我们进一步将模型扩展至包含零下界（ZLB）的情形，并表明最优政策支持预防性宽松。

title: Social Defaults and Plan Choice: The Case of Spousal Following
title_zh: 社会默认与计划选择：配偶跟随的案例
title_primary: 社会默认与计划选择：配偶跟随的案例
title_secondary: Social Defaults and Plan Choice: The Case of Spousal Following
authors: Gross, Tal, Layton, Tim, Prinz, Daniel, Yates, Julia
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review: Insights · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We study how couples in the Medicare Part D program choose an insurance plan. Over 70 percent of enrollees choose the same plan as their spouse. Even among those with differing healthcare needs, well over half do so. Discrete-choice models suggest beneficiaries value being on the same plan as their spouse at hundreds of dollars per year. A regression-discontinuity design shows that quasi-random variation in an older spouse's choice of plan affects their younger spouse's choice. We present a decomposition exercise to assess how much the tendency for couples to choose the same plan contributes to overspending in the program.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了医疗保险D部分计划中夫妻如何选择保险计划。超过70%的参保者选择与配偶相同的计划。即便在医疗需求不同的夫妻中，也有超过半数这样做。离散选择模型显示，受益人每年愿意为与配偶选择同一计划支付数百美元。断点回归设计表明，年长配偶计划选择的准随机变化会影响年轻配偶的选择。我们进行了分解分析，以评估夫妻倾向于选择相同计划对计划中过度支出的贡献程度。

title: Quantifying the China discourse
title_zh: 量化中国话语
title_primary: 量化中国话语
title_secondary: Quantifying the China discourse
authors: Mert Geyiktepe, Dani Rodrik
official: 官方在线 2026-08-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Policy narratives in the US on China have undergone a dramatic transformation in recent years. This column draws on various kinds of public records and employs text-as-data methods to examine the evolution of the US discourse on China over time and also across different sources of public narrative. Whereas the 19th century demonstrates oscillating trends, a clearer pattern emerges in the latter half of the 20th century, one driven less by fluctuating developments and more by ideological and political patterns. The overall trends in net sentiment suggest an interesting contrast between presidential discourse and other sources, with presidential speech appearing to have been a follower.
abstract_zh: 近年来，美国对华政策叙事经历了戏剧性的转变。本文基于多种公共记录，运用文本即数据的方法，考察了美国对华话语随时间演变的情况，以及不同公共叙事来源间的差异。尽管19世纪呈现出波动趋势，但20世纪后半叶则显现出更为清晰的模式，这一模式更多受意识形态和政治格局驱动，而非不断变化的事件。总体情感趋势显示，总统话语与其他来源之间存在有趣的对比，总统演讲似乎更多是跟随者而非引领者。

title: Housing restriction policies and internal migration
title_zh: 住房限制政策与内部迁移
title_primary: 住房限制政策与内部迁移
title_secondary: Housing restriction policies and internal migration
authors: Lyu, Xueying, Yang, Siqiang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates the impacts of housing purchase restrictions on internal migration and household tenure choices in Chinese cities. We develop a spatial model that incorporates individuals’ migration and tenure decisions across cities. The model predicts that potentially affected homebuyers will either switch destinations or change tenure choices, depending on heterogeneous city characteristics. Utilizing the China Migrants Dynamic Survey and a difference-in-differences approach, we examine the model’s implications and find that the restrictions lead to a decrease in migration inflows and a reduced proportion of homeowners among migrants in the restricted cities relative to the unrestricted ones. However, this overall pattern masks important heterogeneity across cities: incoming migrants are more likely to adjust their tenure choices when restricted cities offer better development prospects or desirable living conditions, and they are more inclined to relocate to alternative destinations when such attributes are lacking. These findings highlight the importance of considering unintended consequences on migration when designing housing policies.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了住房购买限制对中国城市内部迁移及家庭住房产权选择的影响。我们构建了一个空间模型，该模型整合了个人跨城市的迁移与产权决策。模型预测，受潜在影响的购房者将根据城市特征的异质性，要么转换目的地，要么调整产权选择。利用中国流动人口动态监测调查数据及双重差分方法，我们检验了模型的推论，发现相较于未受限城市，限制措施导致受限城市的迁移流入量减少，且迁移者中房屋所有者的比例下降。然而，这一总体趋势掩盖了城市间的重要差异：当受限城市提供更好的发展前景或宜居条件时，迁入的迁移者更可能调整其产权选择；而当这些特质缺失时，他们则更倾向于转向其他目的地。这些发现强调了在设计住房政策时考虑对迁移产生的非预期后果的重要性。

title: Trade policy in a model of sequential production
title_zh: 序贯生产模型中的贸易政策
title_primary: 序贯生产模型中的贸易政策
title_secondary: Trade policy in a model of sequential production
authors: Hartmut Egger, Christian Fischer-Thöne
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We develop a two-country trade model with sequential production in which a technologically backward economy exports intermediates in exchange for final goods from a technologically advanced economy. The advanced country can raise welfare by imposing import tariffs on intermediates, whereas export tariffs on intermediates or import tariffs on final goods are ineffective for the backward economy. Instead, the backward economy resorts to a quantitative export constraint, diverting part of its labor force into a less efficient autarkic production process. We show that non-cooperative policy choices reduce trade and lower welfare in both countries, underscoring the need for a trade agreement. To sustain mutually beneficial liberalization after prior tariff reductions, however, an agreement may have to link tariff cuts to the removal of export constraints, particularly when lifting these constraints is costly for the backward economy.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含序贯生产的两国贸易模型，其中技术落后的经济体出口中间品，以换取技术先进经济体的最终产品。先进国家可以通过对中间品征收进口关税来提高福利，而对落后经济体而言，对中间品征收出口关税或对最终产品征收进口关税则无效。相反，落后经济体转而采取数量性出口限制，将部分劳动力转移至效率较低的封闭式生产过程中。我们证明，非合作的政策选择会减少贸易并降低两国福利，凸显了贸易协定的必要性。然而，在先前关税削减之后，为维持互利的自由化，协定可能必须将关税削减与取消出口限制挂钩，尤其是在解除这些限制对落后经济体而言成本高昂的情况下。

title: A Static Capital Buffer is Hard To Beat
title_zh: 静态资本缓冲难以被超越
title_primary: 静态资本缓冲难以被超越
title_secondary: A Static Capital Buffer is Hard To Beat
authors: Canzoneri, Matthew, Diba, Behzad, Guerrieri, Luca, Mishin, Arsenii
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: In a model with endogenous risk-taking, deposit insurance and limited liability may lead banks to make risky loans that are socially inefficient. Capital requirements can prevent excessive risk-taking at the cost of reducing liquidity-producing bank deposits. A policy that sets capital requirements just high enough to prevent excessive risktaking will move capital requirements pro-, counter-, or a-cyclically depending on the shock source. However, such a policy requires full knowledge of all the shocks hitting the economy and is not implementable. Simple rules that respond to cyclical conditions—in line with Basel III guidance—perform poorly, whereas a small static capital buffer can do much better.
abstract_zh: 在包含内生风险承担行为的模型中，存款保险与有限责任制度可能导致银行发放社会效率低下的高风险贷款。资本充足率要求能够抑制过度风险承担，但代价是减少创造流动性的银行存款。若将资本充足率设定为恰好足以防止过度风险承担的水平，该政策将根据冲击来源呈现顺周期、逆周期或非周期性特征。然而，此类政策要求完全掌握影响经济的各类冲击信息，在实践中难以实施。遵循巴塞尔III指引的周期性调节规则表现欠佳，而小规模静态资本缓冲却能取得显著更优效果。

title: Lifelong learning is becoming increasingly important in response to labour market transformations
title_zh: 终身学习在应对劳动力市场转型中的重要性日益凸显
title_primary: 终身学习在应对劳动力市场转型中的重要性日益凸显
title_secondary: Lifelong learning is becoming increasingly important in response to labour market transformations
authors: Isaure Delaporte, Verónica Escudero, Hannah Liepmann
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: As digital, environmental, and demographic transformations reshape labour markets, skills influence who benefits from these changes and who falls behind. This column presents the findings of an International Labour Organization report that shows that socio-emotional and cognitive skills are in high demand and that employers seek rounded skills profiles. However, most countries still lack ambitious lifelong learning systems. The inclusiveness, quality, and adaptability of such systems will influence how economies and societies navigate structural transformation.
abstract_zh: 随着数字化、环境与人口结构的转型重塑劳动力市场，技能决定了谁能从这些变革中受益、谁又将落后。本专栏介绍了国际劳工组织一份报告的研究发现：社会情感技能与认知技能需求旺盛，雇主更青睐综合型技能人才。然而，多数国家仍缺乏具有前瞻性的终身学习体系。这类体系的包容性、质量与适应性，将深刻影响各经济体与社会如何应对结构性转型。

title: Economic Models of Identity Formation and Cultural Transmission
title_zh: 身份形成与文化传播的经济学模型
title_primary: 身份形成与文化传播的经济学模型
title_secondary: Economic Models of Identity Formation and Cultural Transmission
authors: Alberto Bisin, Thierry Verdier
official: 官方在线 2026-07-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: In this paper we survey recent advances in the economic theory of identity formation. We restrict our analysis to models which conceptualize identity formation as embedded into an inter-generational cultural transmission process, and therefore have implications for the dynamics of social identity. Through the lens of a general framework linking identity formation to cultural evolution, we discuss issues related to the dynamics of oppositional, racial, or minority attitudes, cultural polarization, identity switching, and openness to alternative identities. An application of the set-up to multidimensional identities constructed from combinations of characteristics, provides conditions under which societies converge (or not) toward narrow identities centered on salient markers such as religion, ethnicity, or race. We conclude by outlining promising avenues for future research.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了身份认同形成的经济学理论最新进展。我们将分析范围限定于将身份认同形成嵌入代际文化传播过程的模型，这类模型对社会身份认同的动态演变具有重要启示。通过构建连接身份认同形成与文化演化的通用分析框架，我们探讨了对抗性态度、种族或少数群体态度、文化极化、身份转换以及对替代性身份认同的开放性等议题的动态特征。将该框架应用于由多重特征组合构建的多维身份认同，揭示了社会在何种条件下会（或不会）收敛于以宗教、族裔或种族等显著标识为核心的狭隘身份认同。最后，我们指出了未来研究富有前景的方向。

title: Visual bias in the Brexit referendum: A quantitative analysis of newspaper images
title_zh: 英国脱欧公投中的视觉偏见：报纸图像的定量分析
title_primary: 英国脱欧公投中的视觉偏见：报纸图像的定量分析
title_secondary: Visual bias in the Brexit referendum: A quantitative analysis of newspaper images
authors: Wanyu Chung, Duiyi Dai, Robert J.R. Elliott
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In this paper, we investigate whether, and to what extent, UK newspapers exhibited image-based bias in their portrayal of politicians during the 2016 Brexit referendum. We use computer vision and machine learning techniques to first, identify the faces of politicians and assess the emotional content conveyed through their expressions and second, to measure the contextual sentiment of the overall image, including elements such as background, objects, and color. Our findings reveal that tabloid newspapers displayed significant partisan bias. Specifically, pro-leave tabloids were more likely to depict pro-leave politicians with positive facial expressions and in more favorable visual contexts, while pro-remain politicians were portrayed more negatively. This bias was especially pronounced in front-page images and those featuring key political figures, while no comparable patterns were found in broadsheets. However, the visual bias diminished immediately after the referendum vote. Our scalable framework not only provides a systematic way to detect visual bias in political imagery but also underscores the growing need for media accountability and visual literacy as images play an increasingly powerful role in shaping political communication.
abstract_zh: 本文探究了2016年英国脱欧公投期间，英国报纸在描绘政治人物时是否存在以及多大程度上存在基于图像的偏见。我们运用计算机视觉与机器学习技术，首先识别政治人物的面部并评估其表情所传达的情感内容，其次衡量整体图像的语境情感，包括背景、物体和色彩等元素。研究结果显示，小报呈现出显著的党派偏见。具体而言，支持脱欧的小报更倾向于以积极的面部表情和更有利的视觉语境描绘支持脱欧的政治人物，而支持留欧的政治人物则被更负面地呈现。这种偏见在头版图像及关键政治人物特写中尤为突出，而大报中未发现类似模式。然而，视觉偏见在公投投票结束后立即减弱。我们提出的可扩展框架不仅为检测政治图像中的视觉偏见提供了系统性方法，也凸显了随着图像在塑造政治传播中日益增强的作用，媒体问责与视觉素养的需求正不断增长。

title: Voluntary Collective Action to Address Growing Agricultural Challenges in Two Countries: Experimental Insights and Commonalities
title_zh: 两国应对日益严峻农业挑战的自愿集体行动：实验洞见与共性
title_primary: 两国应对日益严峻农业挑战的自愿集体行动：实验洞见与共性
title_secondary: Voluntary Collective Action to Address Growing Agricultural Challenges in Two Countries: Experimental Insights and Commonalities
authors: Ariel Singerman, Sergio H. Lence
official: 官方在线 2026-07-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We conducted two framed field economic experiments with citrus farmers in Florida, United States and soybean farmers in Argentina to investigate their willingness to coordinate pest and weed management efforts. Despite the contrast between these two agricultural contexts, we find striking behavioral commonalities. In both countries, farmers display aversion to strategic uncertainty, rely heavily on beliefs about their neighbors' actions when deciding whether to participate, and systematically underestimate the probability of successful coordination even when opportunity costs are low. These common findings across such different settings suggest that the underlying mechanisms are not context‐specific but instead reflect more general features of decision‐making under strategic interdependence, lending support to the external validity of our findings. The results highlight key psychological and economic barriers to cooperation and offer policy‐relevant insights for designing interventions to enhance participation in voluntary area‐wide pest management programs. While voluntary coordination can enhance pest management effectiveness and be pareto‐optimal, the success of the collective action depends on overcoming farmers' reluctance to participate. The evidence that farmers systematically underestimate the probability of successful coordination even when opportunity costs are low highlights a key behavioral barrier that can lead to coordination failures. Interventions that mitigate strategic uncertainty and build trust among participants—such as targeted subsidies or technical assistance—could encourage participation among farmers who would otherwise be unwilling to engage in coordinated efforts. Beyond the immediate application to pest and weed resistance management, our findings contribute to a broader understanding of cooperative behavior among farmers in the presence of strategic uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我们与美国佛罗里达州柑橘种植户及阿根廷大豆种植户合作开展了两项框架田野经济实验，旨在探究农户参与病虫害与杂草协同治理的意愿。尽管两国农业情境存在显著差异，但研究发现惊人的行为共性：两国农户均表现出对战略不确定性的规避倾向，其参与决策高度依赖对邻居行为的信念，且即便机会成本较低时仍系统性低估协同成功的概率。这些跨情境的共性发现表明，潜在机制并非情境特异性，而是反映了战略依存条件下决策的普遍特征，从而支持了研究结论的外部有效性。研究结果揭示了阻碍合作的关键心理与经济壁垒，为设计提升自愿性区域病虫害协同治理项目参与度的干预措施提供了政策启示。尽管自愿协同能提升病虫害治理效率并实现帕累托最优，但集体行动的成功取决于能否克服农户的参与惰性。农户在机会成本较低时仍系统性低估协同成功概率的证据，凸显了导致协同失灵的关键行为障碍。通过定向补贴或技术援助等缓解战略不确定性、建立参与者信任的干预措施，可促使原本不愿参与协同行动的农户加入。除直接应用于病虫害抗性治理外，本研究还为理解战略不确定性下农户合作行为提供了更广泛的理论视角。

title: Brazil's VAT Reform: Improving Equity
title_zh: 巴西增值税改革：提升公平性
title_primary: 巴西增值税改革：提升公平性
title_secondary: Brazil's VAT Reform: Improving Equity
authors: Ana Cebreiro Gomez & Ms. Christina Kolerus
official: 官方在线 2026-06-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: After decades in the making, Brazil’s landmark VAT reform was approved in 2023. The primary objective of the reform is to eliminate distortions and reduce the complexity of the current consumption tax system while maintaining revenue neutrality. In addition, specific design features were included to alleviate the VAT’s inherent regressivity and improve the equity of the Brazilian tax system. This paper assesses the reform’s expected equity print leveraging a microstatic model based on household data and simulates policy options to further improve distributional outcomes. While the new VAT achieves a fairly equal distribution of the tax burden across most income groups, the poorest still carry a heavier load in terms of their disposable income. Dissecting the impact by policy instrument, the reform’s approved reduced rates aggravate regressivity, while zero rates and the new cashback lower the tax burden for poorer households, under the revenue neutrality assumption. Overall, the combined use of these measures dampens the reform’s equity outcomes somewhat as a higher VAT reference rate is required on all other items to maintain revenue neutrality. The paper also shows that some equity improvements stem from the reform’s implied pivot towards taxing services. Finally, simulations show that focusing on and expanding the cashback could amplify equity gains by raising the poorest disposable income by 25 percent via reductions in their tax liability.
abstract_zh: 历经数十年酝酿，巴西里程碑式的增值税改革于2023年获批。此次改革的首要目标是在保持税收中性前提下，消除现行消费税体系的扭曲效应并降低其复杂性。此外，改革还纳入了特定设计特征，以缓解增值税固有的累退性，提升巴西税收体系的公平性。本文基于家庭数据的微观静态模型评估了改革预期的公平性影响，并模拟了进一步改善分配结果的备选政策方案。尽管新增值税制在多数收入群体间实现了较为均衡的税负分配，但最贫困群体在可支配收入层面仍承担着更重的负担。按政策工具分解影响可见：在税收中性假设下，改革批准的优惠税率加剧了累退性，而零税率与新推行的现金返还机制则降低了贫困家庭的税负。总体而言，这些措施的联合使用在一定程度上削弱了改革的公平性效果——为维持税收中性，所有其他商品需适用更高的增值税基准税率。本文还表明，部分公平性改善源于改革隐含的服务业征税重心转移。最后，模拟结果显示，聚焦并扩大现金返还机制可通过减少贫困群体税负使其可支配收入提升25%，从而放大公平性收益。

title: International Trade in an Uncertain World
title_zh: 不确定世界中的国际贸易
title_primary: 不确定世界中的国际贸易
title_secondary: International Trade in an Uncertain World
authors: Benny Kleinman, Ernest Liu, Stephen Redding, David Xu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a tractable quantitative model of international trade in which agents make bilateral investments in resilience under general equilibrium uncertainty. Under both complete and incomplete financial markets, we show that these bilateral investments solve a portfolio problem of choosing trade partners. Countries’ risk profiles become determinants of trade flows, income and welfare, whose first moments are affected by the second moments of productivity and trade costs. Changes in global economic uncertainty have heterogeneous effects across countries, depending on how they affect real hedging opportunities. The opening of trade can raise or reduce income volatility, but is revealed-preferred to autarky.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个可量化的国际贸易模型，其中经济主体在一般均衡不确定性下对韧性进行双边投资。在完全金融市场与不完全金融市场两种情形下，我们证明这些双边投资可归结为选择贸易伙伴的投资组合问题。国家的风险特征成为贸易流量、收入与福利的决定因素，而这些变量的第一矩受生产率与贸易成本第二矩的影响。全球经济不确定性的变化对不同国家产生异质性影响，其作用方向取决于这些变化如何影响实际对冲机会。贸易开放可能提高或降低收入波动性，但通过显示性偏好优于自给自足状态。

title: Modelling the structural and land use effects of support policies for the expansion of organic farming: The case of organic dairy farms in France
title_zh: 模拟有机农业扩张支持政策的结构与土地利用效应：法国有机奶牛养殖案例
title_primary: 模拟有机农业扩张支持政策的结构与土地利用效应：法国有机奶牛养殖案例
title_secondary: Modelling the structural and land use effects of support policies for the expansion of organic farming: The case of organic dairy farms in France
authors: M. Schiavo, P.M. Aubert, C. Le Mouël
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Organic farming is increasingly recognised as a promising agricultural model, yet limited research has explored the mechanisms driving farm conversion in response to economic and policy incentives and how they affect the land market and alter the structure of conventional and organic farms. This study employs an agent-based model to assess the effects of policy measures supporting organic farming in the French dairy sector, representing different types of conventional and organic dairy farms. Results show that policy interventions can effectively increase organic acreage and support progress toward the European Commission’s target of 25% organic farmland, as outlined in the Farm to Fork and Biodiversity Strategies. Provided our modelling assumptions, particularly fixed output and input prices (except for land) and the rule governing farm conversion, among the measures analysed, per-hectare subsidies for organic farms are more cost-effective in promoting organic land expansion than taxes on fertilisers and pesticides for conventional farms. Redirecting subsidies to support agricultural employment contributes to organic growth, albeit less efficiently than the other measures. The 25% target can also be achieved by improving the organic farms productivity, reducing the amount of labour and capital needed to produce the same output by −6.8%, although the cost-effectiveness of such an intervention cannot be assessed. Policy instruments affect conventional farm types unevenly, with different groups more adversely affected depending on the policy. Finally, growth in organic land is mainly driven by the conversion of conventional farms rather than expansion of land within initially present organic farms.
abstract_zh: 有机农业日益被视为一种前景广阔的农业模式，然而，关于经济与政策激励如何驱动农场转型及其对土地市场的影响，以及如何改变传统与有机农场结构的研究仍相对有限。本研究采用基于主体的模型，评估支持法国乳制品行业有机农业的政策措施效果，该模型代表了不同类型的传统及有机奶牛养殖场。研究结果显示，政策干预能有效增加有机种植面积，并助力实现欧盟委员会在“从农场到餐桌”及“生物多样性战略”中提出的25%有机农田目标。基于我们的建模假设，特别是固定产出与投入价格（土地除外）及农场转型规则，在所分析的措施中，对有机农场按公顷补贴比向传统农场征收化肥和农药税更具成本效益，更能促进有机土地扩张。将补贴转用于支持农业就业虽能促进有机增长，但效率低于其他措施。通过提升有机农场生产率，即减少生产同等产出所需劳动力和资本6.8%，也可实现25%的目标，尽管此类干预的成本效益无法评估。政策工具对不同类型的传统农场影响不均，不同群体所受不利影响因政策而异。最后，有机土地的增长主要源于传统农场的转型，而非初始有机农场内部土地的扩张。

title: Innovation and politics: How the revolution affected the Cuban patent network, 1947‒1976
title_zh: 创新与政治：革命如何影响古巴专利网络，1947—1976
title_primary: 创新与政治：革命如何影响古巴专利网络，1947—1976
title_secondary: Innovation and politics: How the revolution affected the Cuban patent network, 1947‒1976
authors: Sergio Barbosa, Patricio Sáiz, José L. Zofío
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates how the Cuban Revolution of 1959—a shock that marked the country’s transition from a capitalist to a socialist economy—reshaped the structure and dynamics of Cuba’s innovation system between 1947 and 1976, with effects that still endure today. Drawing on historical patent data and social network analysis, the paper examines shifts in innovators’ connectivity, clustering, and centrality, offering new insights into the long-term effects of institutional and geopolitical changes on innovation and economic trajectories, particularly in developing economies. The analysis reveals i) the dominant role of U.S. companies, especially in the pharmaceutical and chemical sectors during the 1950s; ii) the impact of the revolution’s structural changes on the decline of patent activities and the attrition of the collaborative network; and iii) the subsequent emergence of innovation paths fostered by state-led initiatives and new international collaborations. The results underscore the key and evolving role of both Cuban public institutions and U.S. foreign policy, the resilience of central actors in the patent network—including several U.S. corporations that continued protecting their inventions despite the trade embargo—and the relative success of domestic initiatives in healthcare and pharmaceuticals. However, the findings also demonstrate how innovation ties became geographically concentrated after the revolution, as the international relationships of the island shifted. Overall, this research contextualizes contemporary debates on structural change and innovation dynamics regarding the role of public/private institutions, the implications of intellectual property rights, the importance of collaboration and absorptive capacities, or the influence of geopolitical realignments.

title: New brooms sweep cleaner? political term and air pollution governance
title_zh: 新扫帚扫得更干净？政治任期与空气污染治理
title_primary: 新扫帚扫得更干净？政治任期与空气污染治理
title_secondary: New brooms sweep cleaner? political term and air pollution governance
authors: Lafang Wang, Lunbo Zhang, Wenjing Kuai, Dan Qu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Political agency models predict that officials with higher continuation values of office exert greater effort when observable performance is tied to career rewards. We test this prediction in China’s top-down cadre system, where the 2012 leadership reshuffle following the 18th Chinese Communist Party Congress coincided with the elevation of PM2.5 reduction to an explicit cadre-evaluation criterion. Using data from Chinese prefecture-level cities between 2008 and 2015, we implement a difference-in-differences design comparing cities led by first-term and reappointed leaders. We find that post-2012, first-term leaders achieved larger PM2.5 reductions than reappointed leaders. This gap reflects first-term leaders’ longer career horizons and weaker pre-existing capture relationships with incumbent polluters. Consistent with multitask incentive theory, first-term leaders exert greater effort on measurable, fast-acting administrative instruments such as production restrictions, while green subsidies and technological innovation show no significant term-stage difference. The paper provides new evidence on political agency, regulatory capture, and multitask incentives in top-down bureaucratic systems.
abstract_zh: 政治代理模型预测，当可观测的绩效与职业回报挂钩时，拥有更高任职延续价值的官员会付出更多努力。我们在中国自上而下的干部体系中检验了这一预测，该体系中2012年第十八届中国共产党全国代表大会后的领导层换届恰逢PM2.5减排被明确纳入干部考核标准。利用2008年至2015年间中国地级市的数据，我们采用双重差分设计，比较首任与连任领导所在城市的表现。研究发现，2012年后，首任领导所在城市的PM2.5降幅大于连任领导所在城市。这一差距反映了首任领导更长的职业前景以及与现有污染企业之间较弱的既有俘获关系。与多任务激励理论一致，首任领导在可衡量、见效快的行政手段（如生产限制）上投入更多努力，而绿色补贴和技术创新方面则未显示出显著的任期阶段差异。本文为自上而下官僚体系中的政治代理、监管俘获及多任务激励提供了新的证据。

abstract: The rise of machine learning (ML) is one of the most prominent developments in applied econometrics in the past decade. The focus of much economic analysis is causal, rather than prediction, and Belloni et al. (2014) demonstrate how ML methods can be used in causal inference. This paper undertakes a narrow and wide replication of the Monte Carlo and empirical examples presented by Belloni et al. (2014). We discuss practical implications of this replication for the use of double ML methods in applied econometric research.
abstract_zh: 机器学习（ML）的兴起是过去十年应用计量经济学领域最显著的发展之一。许多经济分析的重点在于因果推断，而非预测，Belloni等人（2014）展示了如何将机器学习方法应用于因果推断。本文对Belloni等人（2014）提出的蒙特卡洛模拟和实证案例进行了狭义与广义的复制研究。我们探讨了此次复制对于在应用计量经济学研究中使用双重机器学习方法的实际意义。

abstract: With an exhausting land frontier, raising agricultural production to meet future global demand for food is highly contingent on higher crop yields. Yet, continued yield growth is increasingly threatened by climate change. This paper presents new evidence on significant effects of climate change on yields across ten major crops for 563 districts of India over half a century. The impacts are larger than those in the literature not only for India, but also relative to global benchmarks. Larger impacts are attributable to our use of a dynamic specification to capture persistence and to making an allowance for nonlinearity of marginal effects. We estimate 1◦C higher temperature reduces the national average all-crop yield by 8%. For individual crops, yield losses are as high as 16% for maize and 19% for pearl millet. For individual districts, they range from under 1% to 39%
abstract_zh: 随着土地开发边界日趋饱和，提高农业生产以满足未来全球粮食需求高度依赖于作物单产的提升。然而，持续的单产增长正日益受到气候变化的威胁。本文基于印度563个地区半个世纪以来十种主要作物的数据，提供了气候变化对作物单产产生显著影响的新证据。其影响程度不仅超过现有文献中针对印度的研究结论，也高于全球基准水平。这种更显著的影响归因于我们采用动态模型来捕捉持续性效应，并允许边际效应存在非线性特征。研究估算表明，温度每升高1°C，全国所有作物平均单产将下降8%。就具体作物而言，玉米单产损失高达16%，珍珠粟达19%。就具体地区而言，单产损失幅度从不足1%到39%不等。

title: Optimal Unemployment Insurance Requirements
title_zh: 最优失业保险要求
title_primary: 最优失业保险要求
title_secondary: Optimal Unemployment Insurance Requirements
authors: Gustavo de Souza, André Victor D. Luduvice
official: 官方在线 2026-04-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In the United States, workers must satisfy two requirements to receive unemployment insurance (UI): a tenure requirement of a minimum work spell and a monetary requirement of past minimum earnings. Using discontinuity of UI rules at state borders, we find that both requirements reduce unemployment and that the monetary requirement decreases the number of employers and the share of part-time workers, while the tenure requirement has the opposite effect. We develop a heterogeneous agents model with history-dependent UI benefits to explain these results and quantify an optimal utilitarian UI design. The optimal policy has a high monetary and a short tenure requirement.
abstract_zh: 在美国，工人必须满足两项要求才能领取失业保险（UI）：一项是最低工作期限的任职要求，另一项是过去最低收入的经济要求。利用州界处失业保险规则的不连续性，我们发现这两项要求均降低了失业率，且经济要求减少了雇主数量及兼职工作者比例，而任职要求则产生相反效果。我们构建了一个具有历史依赖型失业保险福利的异质性主体模型，以解释这些结果并量化最优功利主义失业保险设计。最优政策包含较高的经济要求和较短的任职要求。

title: Sustainable Productivity Growth in Agriculture: The Role of Shifts in R&D Investments and Technology
title_zh: 农业可持续生产率增长：研发投资与技术变迁的作用
title_primary: 农业可持续生产率增长：研发投资与技术变迁的作用
title_secondary: Sustainable Productivity Growth in Agriculture: The Role of Shifts in R&D Investments and Technology
authors: Zuzana Smeets Křístková, Michiel van Dijk, Robert M'Barek, Hans van Meijl, Tomas Ratinger
official: 官方在线 2026-04-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The objective of the paper is to evaluate the long‐term prospects of sustainable productivity growth linked to plausible assumptions on public agricultural R&D investments as the key productivity driver. Second, it investigates the role of changing R&D focus from yield maximization to input saving technologies (fertilizers and pesticides). The projections using CGE model MAGNET identify China, India and Brazil as regions with high productivity growth from agricultural R&D while Sub‐Saharan Africa regions will struggle with low productivity growth rates and substantial increase in GHG emissions. Overall, GHG emissions are projected to grow more than agricultural output. However it is found that sustainable agricultural productivity growth could become feasible under the reorientation of R&D programs in high income countries (with use of chemical inputs declining as much as 30%) where these policies can make an important contribution to sustainability while food security concerns are limited and spillover effects in terms of higher food prices are low.
abstract_zh: 本文旨在评估与公共农业研发投资作为关键生产力驱动因素的合理假设相关的可持续生产力增长的长期前景。其次，探讨了研发重点从追求产量最大化转向节约投入技术（化肥和农药）所产生的影响。利用CGE模型MAGNET进行的预测显示，中国、印度和巴西是农业研发带来高生产力增长的地区，而撒哈拉以南非洲地区则面临低生产力增长率及温室气体排放显著增加的困境。总体而言，预计温室气体排放的增长将超过农业产出的增长。然而，研究发现，在高收入国家重新调整研发项目方向（化学投入品使用量下降高达30%）的情况下，可持续农业生产力增长或可实现，这些政策在粮食安全担忧有限且食品价格上涨的溢出效应较低的情况下，能够为可持续性做出重要贡献。

title: Managed decline: Muddling through with the Sterling (dis)Agreements, 1968–74
title_zh: 管理式衰落：1968-74年英镑（不）协定的艰难应对
title_primary: 管理式衰落：1968-74年英镑（不）协定的艰难应对
title_secondary: Managed decline: Muddling through with the Sterling (dis)Agreements, 1968–74
authors: Alan de Bromhead, David Jordan, Francis Kennedy, Jack Seddon
official: 官方在线 2025-10-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract How do policymakers manage the decline of an international currency? This paper revisits the view that the ‘Sterling Agreements’ of 1968–74 – bilateral contracts between the UK and sterling‐holding governments – marked a successful paradigm shift towards sterling's managed ‘retirement’. Archival evidence reveals no strategic coherence to British policy in this period, a case of ‘muddling through’. Phased reductions in the amount of sterling protected by ‘guarantee’ were presented as steps on a path to ‘winding down’ sterling. But, when given options, British officials prioritized maintaining, rather than reducing, international sterling holdings, and the Agreements, if anything, tended to encourage their increase. Sterling's relative decline resulted more from sterling area countries seeking financial freedom, as the Bank of England – the Agreements’ designer and defender – lost policy influence.
abstract_zh: 摘要 政策制定者如何管理国际货币的衰落？本文重新审视了1968-74年“英镑协议”——英国与持有英镑的政府之间的双边合同——标志着英镑有序“退休”的成功范式转变的观点。档案证据显示，英国在这一时期的政策缺乏战略连贯性，属于“摸着石头过河”的情况。受“保证”保护的英镑金额分阶段减少，被呈现为走向英镑“逐步退出”的路径。然而，当面临选择时，英国官员优先考虑维持而非减少国际英镑持有量，而这些协议，若有影响，反而倾向于鼓励其增加。英镑的相对衰落更多源于英镑区国家寻求金融自由，而作为协议设计者和捍卫者的英格兰银行，其政策影响力逐渐减弱。

title: Partial identification of structural vector autoregressions with non-centred stochastic volatility
title_zh: 非中心随机波动下结构向量自回归的部分识别
title_primary: 非中心随机波动下结构向量自回归的部分识别
title_secondary: Partial identification of structural vector autoregressions with non-centred stochastic volatility
authors: Helmut Lütkepohl, Fei Shang, Luis Uzeda, Tomasz Woźniak
official: 官方在线 2025-10-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We consider structural vector autoregressions that are identified through stochastic volatility under Bayesian estimation. Three contributions emerge from our exercise. First, we show that a non-centred parameterization of stochastic volatility yields a marginal prior for the conditional variances of structural shocks that is centred on homoskedasticity, with strong shrinkage and heavy tails—unlike the common centred parameterization. This feature makes it well suited for assessing partial identification of any shock of interest. Second, Monte Carlo experiments on small and large systems indicate that the non-centred setup estimates structural parameters more precisely and normalizes conditional variances efficiently. Third, revisiting prominent fiscal structural vector autoregressions, we show how the non-centred approach identifies tax shocks that are consistent with estimates reported in the literature.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑在贝叶斯估计下通过随机波动率识别的结构向量自回归模型。我们的研究贡献有三点。首先，我们展示了随机波动率的非中心参数化能为结构冲击的条件方差产生一个以同方差性为中心的先验边际分布，该分布具有强收缩和重尾特性——这与常见的中心参数化不同。这一特性使其非常适合评估任何感兴趣冲击的部分识别。其次，针对小型和大型系统的蒙特卡洛实验表明，非中心设定能更精确地估计结构参数，并有效规范化条件方差。第三，重新审视著名的财政结构向量自回归模型，我们展示了非中心方法如何识别出与文献中报告估计一致的税收冲击。

title: Local Labor Markets and Selection into the Teaching Profession
title_zh: 地方劳动力市场与教师职业选择
title_primary: 地方劳动力市场与教师职业选择
title_secondary: Local Labor Markets and Selection into the Teaching Profession
authors: Christa Deneault
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2025-10-08 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Using administrative data from Texas, I track individuals from high school through college to the workforce to determine the effects of local labor markets on occupational choice. I find local labor market conditions are countercyclical with selection into teaching. Individuals sorting into teaching because of poor local labor market conditions are of higher ability (standardized tests) and have higher productivity (value-added). The findings suggest local labor market fluctuations shape career decisions well before individuals participate in the labor market, and increasing the relative economic standing of teaching as a career has the potential to improve the future supply of teachers.
abstract_zh: 利用德克萨斯州的行政数据，我追踪个体从高中到大学直至进入劳动力市场的全过程，以探究地方劳动力市场对职业选择的影响。研究发现，地方劳动力市场状况与选择从事教师职业呈逆周期关系。因地方劳动力市场不佳而选择进入教育行业的个体，其能力（以标准化测试衡量）和生产力（以增值衡量）均较高。这些发现表明，地方劳动力市场的波动早在个体进入劳动力市场之前就已塑造其职业决策，而提升教师职业的相对经济地位有望改善未来教师的供给。

title: Measuring risk spillover effects among biofuel-related financial derivatives: based on the modified CoVaR and S-vine copula methods
title_zh: 基于修正CoVaR和S-vine Copula方法的生物燃料相关金融衍生品风险溢出效应测度
title_primary: 基于修正CoVaR和S-vine Copula方法的生物燃料相关金融衍生品风险溢出效应测度
title_secondary: Measuring risk spillover effects among biofuel-related financial derivatives: based on the modified CoVaR and S-vine copula methods
authors: Qingbin Gong Wen Chyi Han Antai College of Economics & Management, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, China
official: 官方在线 2025-08-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates the risk spillover effects among nine biofuel-related assets across three countries. Both dependence structure and tail causal relations are studied with the stationary vine (S-vine) copula model and the quantile Granger causality test. The modified conditional value-at-risk (CoVaR) is proposed to measure the intertemporal risk spillover effects. It extends the traditional CoVaR to account for intertemporal dynamics. Comparatively, the traditional CoVaR may overestimate the risk spillover effects. The empirical results exhibit geographical clusters and potential paths of risk spillovers among biofuel-related assets. The spillover path runs from American markets to Chinese markets via the Malaysian market. American soybean oil is the risk transmitter, while Chinese palm oil is the primary risk recipient. Moreover, the spillover effects of downside risks have increased since the COVID-19. This research provides significant implications for risk management and investment in the biofuel-related markets.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了三个国家九种生物燃料相关资产之间的风险溢出效应。利用平稳藤（S-vine）copula模型和分位数格兰杰因果检验，研究了依赖结构和尾部因果关系。提出了修正的条件风险价值（CoVaR）来衡量跨期风险溢出效应，该指标扩展了传统CoVaR以考虑跨期动态。相比之下，传统CoVaR可能高估风险溢出效应。实证结果显示了生物燃料相关资产间的地理集群和潜在风险溢出路径。溢出路径从美国市场经由马来西亚市场传导至中国市场。美国豆油是风险传递者，而中国棕榈油是主要风险接收者。此外，自COVID-19以来，下行风险溢出效应有所增强。本研究为生物燃料相关市场的风险管理和投资提供了重要启示。
